# BAS Lite App 8 Documentation

App 8 runs as a Docker-based BAS Lite stack built on easy-aso and diy-bacnet-server.

Primary docs:

- `README.md`
- `docs/BOSS_PI_BAS_LITE_DOCKER.md`
- `docs/bas-lite-app8-tutorial.md`
- `docs/replicate-any-building-lan-topology.md`

## BACnet discovery

Discovery is handled via the BACnet JSON-RPC backend and site configuration workflows.
The API compatibility layer at `/app8/api/*` does not expose a standalone discovery endpoint.

## Architecture summary

- `frontend`: React SPA built with Vite, served by nginx
- `api`: FastAPI app using easy-aso supervisor + compatibility routes
- `diy-bacnet`: BACnet UDP + JSON-RPC service
- `caddy`: edge routing, optional TLS/basic auth

## Positioning

This stack is inspired by platform-style BAS operations and focuses on a smaller, operator-friendly runtime footprint.
